description: March 30, 2026 Chiaradio Attends Easter Event in Shubuta Shubuta, MS — Democratic congressional nominee Michael A. Chiaradio attended a community Easter Egg Hunt in Shubuta, spending time with local families and residents as part of his ongoing outreach across Mississippi’s 3rd Congressional District. The event brought together community members of all ages and provided an opportunity for Chiaradio to connect directly with residents in a family-centered setting. His participation reflects a continued focus on local engagement and relationship-building throughout the district. Chiaradio has prioritized attending community events across both rural and urban areas, emphasizing the importance of consistent presence and accessibility in building trust with voters. The campaign continues to expand its grassroots efforts as it works to engage communities across the region. Supporters can contribute to the campaign at: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael-a-chiaradio
title: Chiaradio Attends Easter Event in Shubuta - Michael A Chiaradio
